episodic_summary: As of 14 September, 2022, Nate excitedly shares with Joanna that he taught people vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show the previous Monday. Nate admits that it was a bit nerve-wracking but ultimately a blast, and he even picked up a few new recipes. Joanna congratulates Nate on his cooking show and expresses her intention to tune in, asking about his favorite dish from the show. Nate reveals that coconut milk ice cream is at the top of his list, describing it as smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut twist, and notes that it is dairy-free for those who cannot have lactose or want vegan options. Nate shares a photograph of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon on a table. Joanna praises the ice cream's appearance, commenting on its color and texture, and asks Nate to share the recipe, expressing her desire to try making it. Nate agrees to share the recipe, emphasizing his wish to spread joy through dairy-free options, and invites Joanna to let him know when she makes it. Joanna responds enthusiastically, stating that dairy-free is a must for her, especially for desserts, and mentions that she made a delicious dessert with almond milk the previous Friday. Joanna inquires if Nate has any favorite dairy-free desserts. Nate reiterates that coconut milk ice cream is one of his favorites, but he also loves dairy-free chocolate mousse, describing it as super creamy and tasting like the real thing. Joanna shares that her favorite dairy-free treat is an amazing chocolate raspberry tart with an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache, and fresh raspberries, and she shares a photo of a chocolate tart with raspberries on top. Nate expresses his admiration for the tart and asks Joanna how she made it. Joanna explains that she makes it with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate, and raspberries, noting that it is her favorite for birthdays and special days. Nate expresses his eagerness to try that recipe and asks if Joanna has any other treats to share. Joanna mentions another recipe she enjoys, a delicious dessert made with blueberries, coconut milk, and a gluten-free crust, describing it as creamy and delicious, and shares a photo of a piece of cake with walnuts on top. Nate is impressed and expresses his intention to try that dessert as well, thanking Joanna for her help. Joanna encourages Nate to let her know if he tries it, expressing her confidence that he will enjoy it, and they conclude their conversation with Nate thanking Joanna and saying goodbye.
